fusions.name: Hot Brand
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 4 damage and sets the target [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds, with a 30% chance to leave it [Marked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Brazen Bull
fusions.desc: Hurls a bolt of fire that deals 28 damage that ignores resistances, sets the target [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds and leaves it [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Burning Bars
fusions.desc: Raises a line of burning bars 5 tiles long for 6 seconds. Anything that crosses it is set [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Ember Lattice
fusions.desc: Conjures a lattice of embers around you: every hit you take is 1 lower, your armour rises by 6%, 15% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it, and your fire resistance rises by 10%.
